ModMetaData.name: Parametric
ModMetaData.author: aRed
ModMetaData.description:
Parametric is a lightweight background systems mod. Its first module, Load Support, derives each pawn's carrying capability from its actual body.
Load Support Each pawn gets a Load Support multiplier (healthy = x1.00) worked out from the current state of its legs, core (spine, pelvis, torso) and arms. Missing limbs lower it; prosthetics, bionics, archotech parts and modded replacement parts raise it.
- Works with modded bionics and races without compatibility patches. It reads RimWorld's own part-efficiency system, not DefNames. - Superhuman parts scale nonlinearly (efficiency^2.5 by default). - There is a structural bottleneck: super-legs on a normal spine help, but the spine limits them. - Multiplies the existing carrying capacity, so genes, traits, body size and other mods are kept. Vanilla's Manipulation factor is corrected so arms aren't counted twice. - Optionally also applies to inventory and caravan mass. - Nothing is written to your save. Safe to add or remove mid-game.
Requires Harmony.
